subject: Post-demo: MAP draft + MVP milestones (close date update)
messages:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
To: Sara Bloom <sara@helio.com>, Helio Procurement <procurement@helio.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Nov 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Post-demo: MAP draft + MVP milestones (close date update)

Hi Sara / Helio team —

Thanks again for your time on the demo this morning. As promised, attaching the first draft of the Mutual Action Plan (MAP_v1.2.xlsx) that pulls together the milestones we discussed and proposed owners. High-level recap below: 

- MVP scope (Phase 1): API integration, single-tenant model routing, usage analytics dashboard
- Key milestones and owners:
  • API integration complete — Helio devs (internal) + Redwood infra (jasmine) — target 2027-12-15
  • Security review & SOC checklist — Helio security + Redwood security (monica) — target 2028-01-05
  • Pilot validation (20k tokens/day) — Helio product + Redwood CS (rishi) — target 2028-01-20
- Proposed commercial close: 2028-01-12 (SOW-draft-v0.9.pdf attached as reference)

Open asks for you: 
1) Can you confirm milestone owners on your side (API owner + security reviewer)?
2) Are the dates above feasible given your internal release schedule?
3) Any procurement constraints we should know about (PO cadence, vendor onboarding docs)?

Next steps from our side: Monica will prep the security evidence bundle, Rishi will draft the pilot success criteria, and I’ll update the MAP with any changes from procurement. 

Thanks — looking forward to getting this into a firm timeline.

Best,
Jasmine Liu
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jasmine.liu@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0192

Attachments: MAP_v1.2.xlsx, SOW-draft-v0.9.pdf
From: Sara Bloom <sara@helio.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
Cc: Helio Procurement <procurement@helio.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 1 Dec 2027 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-demo: MAP draft + MVP milestones (close date update)

Hi Jasmine —

Appreciate the rapid follow-up and the clear MAP. After an internal sync just now, a couple of updates on our side that affect the timeline: 

- Senior leadership put a temporary hiring/purchase freeze in place for December while Q4 budgets are finalized. That means procurement won't be able to raise a PO until we clear budgets in mid-January.
- Given the freeze, we want to narrow the initial MVP to the absolute essentials: API integration + basic usage dashboard. Security review remains a blocker but we can run a limited pilot under our internal sandbox to reduce exposure.

New ask from Helio:
1) Can Redwood provide an alternative phased MAP with a smaller Phase 1 (API + dashboard) and a clear Phase 2 for the remaining items?
2) Can we move the commercial close out to 2028-03-15 as a target? Procurement will still aim to prioritize us in Jan, but we want a conservative date for planning.

I'll upload an internal timeline PDF to the shared Drive by EOD for visibility. For now, please rework the MAP and send a two-option path (aggressive Jan close vs phased Mar close) so our execs can see the tradeoffs.

Sorry for the last-minute change — we'll try to accelerate where possible but wanted to be transparent.

Best,
Sara Bloom
Head of Product Operations
Helio Systems
sara@helio.com
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 1 Dec 2027 12:10:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Re: Post-demo: MAP draft + MVP milestones (close date update)

Team — forwarding Sara's note. Key changes: procurement freeze -> customer asks to shrink Phase 1 and reforecast close to 2028-03-15. They explicitly requested a two-option MAP: (A) aggressive (push procurement in Jan for 2028-01-12 close) and (B) phased (Phase 1 minimal, commercial close 2028-03-15).

Proposed internal action items: 
- Monica: prioritize the security evidence bundle for the reduced sandbox pilot (can we scope a shorter checklist that still addresses their audit concerns?). Target: 2027-12-08 for the reduced bundle.
- Rishi: draft two pilot success criteria sets (full pilot vs sandbox pilot). Target: 2027-12-06.
- I will produce MAP_v1.3 with two lanes (Aggressive vs Phased) and annotate dependencies and procurement risk. Target: EOD 2027-12-01.

Also thinking we should include an alternate commercial structure for the phased plan: initial commitment at reduced seat/throughput with an option to expand on purchase order in March. Monica / Rishi — can you both confirm feasibility?

Thanks — I’ll loop legal on the SOW adjustments once we pick a lane.

-J
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
To: Sara Bloom <sara@helio.com>, Helio Procurement <procurement@helio.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 1 Dec 2027 15:02:00 -0800
Subject: Updated: MAP options (Aggressive vs Phased) + next steps

Hi Sara —

Thanks for the transparency and the updated ask. Attached is MAP_v1.3 (two lanes) — distilled summary below for exec review. I also attached an abbreviated SOW variant for the phased option.

Option A — Aggressive (aim for Jan close)
- Scope: Full MVP (API + dashboard + security review + pilot)
- Key dates: API integration 2027-12-15; security evidence 2028-01-05; commercial close 2028-01-12
- Risk: Procurement freeze could delay PO; requires Helio exec sign-off to prioritize vendor onboarding in Jan
- Commercial: Standard SOW (SOW-draft-v0.9.pdf)

Option B — Phased (preferred for conservative planning)
- Scope Phase 1: API integration + basic usage dashboard + limited sandbox pilot
- Phase 1 dates: API integration 2027-12-22; sandbox pilot start 2028-01-10; commercial close (Phase 1) 2028-03-15
- Phase 2: Security-hardening, expanded throughput, production pilot — TBD after PO
- Commercial: Reduced initial commitment with add-on PO for Phase 2 (abbreviated SOW attached)

Next steps / asks from Helio:
1) Please confirm which option your execs prefer for visibility to procurement (reply with "Option A" or "Option B" + any date tweaks).
2) Confirm the name and email of the procurement lead who will process the PO in January (if Option A is chosen).
3) If Option B, share any additional constraints on the sandbox pilot (data allowed, IP constraints).

If I don’t hear back by Friday EOD (2027-12-03) I’ll assume we should proceed with Option B as the conservative default and adjust the MAP accordingly.

Thanks again — attaching MAP_v1.3.xlsx and SOW-phased-v0.1.pdf for reference.

Best,
Jasmine Liu
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jasmine.liu@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0192

Attachments: MAP_v1.3.xlsx, SOW-phased-v0.1.pdf
